newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai Rayong refinery cuts output to 130,000 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Thai Rayong refinery cuts output to 130,000 bpd.

text.p: Rayong Refinery Co is operating its 145,000 barrel per day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) at a reduced 130,000 bpd due to weak domestic demand, sources close the company said on Wednesday.
"When there is need to export then it means that margins are pretty weak. So we prefer not to export and run at levels to meet the domestic demand," the source said.
The company has not decided when it would raise operating rates back to full capacity, he said. The cutback was made late in August.
All refining units at the Rayong refinery were operating smoothly, he added. The company had problems starting up a 45,000 bpd cracker earlier in the year.
The refinery, at Rayong on the eastern Thai seaboard, is a 60-40 joint venture between Shell and the Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT).
